features.title: Give your facility a genuine edge
features.body: OneBase commercial-grade HBOT chambers, infrared saunas, cold therapy and red light devices are among the most sought-after recovery modalities in the industry. With the OneBase app, your members don't just use the equipment; they follow doctor-approved protocols that deliver measurable results. The kind of member experience that earns loyalty.

features.title: Build a community around outcomes that speak for themselves
features.body: OneBase gives you the tools: clinically-backed modalities, a protocol app developed by Dr Scott Sherr, and cutting-edge therapies that signal you're serious about wellness.
